centre-line.name: 1. Centre line
centre-line.note: Thin brown line down the middle, in OSM Carto track rhythms: long dashes = Unpaved (grade2), medium dashes = Off-road (grade3). Slightly thicker than contour lines.

grain.name: 3. Grain (OSM Carto)
grain.note: Unpaved: the OSM Carto grain, dark dots in the class hue, 1.5 x larger, on a fill tinted a little toward brown. Off-road: big grain added on top.

dashes.name: 4. Dashes
dashes.note: Track rhythm across the road, reversed: a darker tint shows in the gaps, so the medium dashes of Off-road look darker than the long dashes of Unpaved.

dashed-casing.name: 2. Dashed casing
dashed-casing.note: Continuous class-coloured fill, dashed outline (as Gaia GPS draws tracks and DMD2 unpaved roads): long dashes = Unpaved, medium dashes = Off-road, the same rhythm as the centre line.
